data.heading: Photosynthesis
data.rubric: Click on the image to know more about photosynthesis.
data.text: The system through which plants send water, glucose, and minerals to their different parts is called transportation.
Plants have two types of tubes to carry out transportation: xylem and phloem.
Xylem is a thick and strong tube which carries water and minerals from the roots to the leaves.
Phloem transports glucose from the leaves to other parts of the plant.
